課程綱要.開課單位: 能源工程研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Theory and Technology of energy storage
課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程的目標是讓同學理解目前的各種儲能技術和背後的運作原理，同時也能了解全球與國內的儲能發展、市場概況、能源政策等議題。內容涵蓋電池、電容、機械儲能、除熱、儲冰、液流電池、電轉氣與燃料電池等。內容上會著重於近年較為重要的鋰電池的技術與實務與整合應用(如電動車、再生能源、微電網等範例)。
課程綱要.授課內容:
"The development and marketing of energy storage.
Introduction of energy storage strategies.
Pumped hydroelectric energy storage.
Compressed air energy storage.
Thermal energy storage.
Power-to-fuel technology.
Hydrogen storage technologies.
Battery energy storage.
Supercapacitor energy storage.
Applications"
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: "鋰離子電池原理與技術, 五南書局. Large Energy Storage Systems Handbook, Frank S. Barnes and Jonah G. Levine, CRC Press. Energy Storage, Robert A. Huggins, Springer. Handbook of batteries, David Linden and Thomas B. Reddy, McGraw-Hill. Electrochemical Supercapacitors, B. E. Conway, Kluwer-Plenum."
課程綱要.授課方式: 講授 研討 個別指導
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Attendance or Quiz: 10 %. Midterm Exam.: 35 %. Final Exam.: 35 %. Final project report: 20%
課程綱要.課程領域: 基礎學科 、 先進材料 、 熱流與能源科技

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程教學目標在於讓學生認識太陽電池的原理、太陽光電(photovoltaics)系統和太陽光電的應用。這門課在最初幾個章節將著重探討太陽光電過程中最重要的二個部分—作為能源來源的太陽光，以即將光能轉換為電能的太陽電池本身的性質。接下來則會提及太陽電池和模組的製造技術，其後是各類太楊光電系統的介紹，包括太陽能汽車、住宅的獨立型電源供給，以及大規模併網電廠等。
課程綱要.授課內容: 這門課是英語授課，授課內容請參考英文說明
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: "Smets A., J?ger K., Isabella O., van Swaaij R., Zeman M., Solar Energy: The physics and engineering of photovoltaic conversion, technologies and systems, UIT, 2016."

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Research Project on Energy Technology Ⅰ
課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程旨在培養學生們於 1. 修課同學將於本課程獲得能源相關領域產品實作之知識與經驗，並創意激發、簡報技巧等專題報告相關能力之訓練。 2.修課同學發揮工程領域的思考邏輯，基於基礎材料與元件理論，發揮創意進行能源議題的創新或是改善，並實際進行產品的製作、量測與分析，以及論文撰寫。 3. 專題實作相關之指導課程。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程主旨在培養學生們於
新式節能、潔能與創能領域之興趣與素養。
修課同學發揮工程領域的思考邏輯，基於基礎材料與元件理論，發揮創意進行能源議題的創新或是改善，並實際進行產品的製作、量測與分析，以及論文撰寫。
修課同學以自主創意激發、結合簡報技巧以及實際執行等專題報告相關能力之訓練，將於本課程獲得節能、潔能與創能領域實作之知識與經驗。
實作領域以節能、潔能與創能領域為主，屬於專題實作相關之指導課程。

課程綱要.課程目標: "This course is designed for senior and graduated students who are interested in computational fluid dynamics (CF). It provides a comprehensive understanding of solving the PDEs in fluid dynamics from physics, mathematics, and numerical technology perspectives. Programming practices are also required to further understand the numerical algorithms."
課程綱要.授課內容:
(1) Navier-Stokes Equations & and Reduced Equations
(2) Model Equations: Diffusion Equation, Elliptic Equation, and Wave Equation
(3) Discretization Methods: Finite Difference, Finite Volume, and spectral method
(4) Taylor Series Expansion and Truncation Error Analysis
(*) Higher Order scheme & Spectral like Scheme
(5) Richardson Extrapolation
(6) Stability, Consistency, and Convergence
(7) Stability Analysis: Fourier (Von Neumann) & Spectral method
(*) Enhancement of the Accuracy: Grid Refinement versus Higher Order Scheme
(8) Explicit & Implicit Methods
(9) Upwind and Flux Splitting Methods
(10) Concepts of Artificial Dissipation
(11) Solving Linear System of Equations:
Narrow banded Matrix: Thomas Algorithm
Different Preconditioning Techniques
(12) Eigenvector Annihilation
(13) Multigrid Method
(14) PDE in curvilinear coordinate.
(15) (Multi-block)-Structured & Unstructured Grids
(16) Compressible Flow in Conservative Form
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Textbook: slices Require Knowledge: Differential Equation, Lineal Algebra, and Computer Programming References: (1) “Computational Techniques for Fluid Dynamics”, Vol I, II by C.A.J Fletcher (2) “Numerical Computation of Internal and External Flows”, Vol. I, II by C. Hirsch (3) “Computational Fluid Dynamics For Engineers” Vol. I by Klaus A. Hoffmann & Steve T. Chiang (4) “Computational Fluid Dynamics. The basics with Applications”, Jon D. Anderson Jr.

課程綱要.開課單位: 能源工程研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程目標: 這門課旨在介紹氫能源包括氫之生產、儲存與數種燃料電池的基本原理與操作，包括熱力學分析、電化學原理、傳輸現象與平衡方程式、單電池之組成元件、電池堆與燃料電池系統。另外也會介紹燃料電池的發展歷史、研發現況與未來展望。
課程綱要.授課內容:
This course begins with an overview of hydrogen energy and the production and storage of hydrogen. Then it introduces the principle and operation of various types of fuel cells. Included are overview of fuel cell technology, the thermodynamics of fuel cells, introduction to electrochemical kinetics, transport-related phenomena and conservation equations for reacting multi-component systems, configuration of individual cell, stack and fuel cell system, fuel cell system design, and fuel cell performance modeling.
Course Contents:
Ch 1, Hydrogen Energy and Fossil Fuels
Ch 2, Introduction to Hydrogen Production Methods
Ch 3, Introduction to Hydrogen Storages
Ch 4, Basics of fuel cells
Ch 5, Thermodynamics of fuel cells
Ch 6, Introduction to electrochemical kinetics
Ch 7, Alkaline oxide fuel cells (AFCs)
Ch 8, Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs)
Ch 9, Direct methanol fuel cells (DMFCs)
Ch 10, Solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs)
Labs: PEM fuel cell operation and testing.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Text: 1. Fuel Cell Fundamentals, 2nd Ed., O‘Hayre et al., John Wiley ＆ Sons, 2009. References: 1. Fuel Cell Systems Explained, 2nd Ed., Larminie and Dicks, Wiley, 2003. 2. Fuel Cells and their applications, Kordesch and Simader, VCH, 1996. 3. Fuel Cell Handbook, Appleby and Foulkes, Nostrand Reinhold, 1989. 4. 燃料電池，黃鎮江編著，全華科技，2003。 5. Journal of Power Sources. 6. International Journal of Hydrogen Energy
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Grading: (Subject to change.) 1. Mid-term Exams 30 ％ 2. Homework ＆ Lab Report 30 ％ 3. Final (Exam or Report) 40 ％
